title: I made a platformer you have to play with your eyes closed
author: cody-fifth-door

comments.author: cody-fifth-door
comments.body:
Made it using the new mediapipe feature we added to the SDK. Let's you track eyes, hands, poses, etc. through the players webcam. Pretty fun!

Play it here: [https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/shut-eye-summit](https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/shut-eye-summit)

comments.author: florodude
comments.body: This is creative and really cool!!

comments.author: DntWry0
comments.body: Great job, might be good to penalize the players score for every time they open their eyes. Otherwise they could just progress by blinking nonstop

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body: Yeah good point! I'll add a lives system. You can actually play it totally via audio cues so you don't even need to peek at all.

replies.author: Plenty-Fox-9219
replies.body:
Have you posted this to r/blindgamers ?

Being blind is kind of a cheat in this game ig, but I bet they would love it.

comments.author: janimator0
comments.body: I feel like paralaxing is counter intuitive for this game as it removes the perception of movement distance.

comments.author: Top_Issue_7032
comments.body: why not just make the whole window black so no-one can cheat it?

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: I believe part of the gameplay is rapidly opening your eyes to assess your surroundings and then closing them to continue the game. NOT meant to make the player remember the entirety of the level to run it blind. But I could be wrong.

replies.author: Top_Issue_7032
replies.body: I meant make the screen black when your eyes are closed. It looks like it just dims the screen. In fact, you can probably drop the camera gimmick and make the screen black whenever the character moves

comments.author: HerbChii
comments.body: this is genius concept, like when you close your eyes, your consciousness gets transferred to character and when you open them you return back to yourself
